title: Standard Refund Policy
body: Most unopened products can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. Opened electronics can be returned within 14 days if all accessories are included.

title: Holiday Return Extension
body: Items purchased between November 1 and December 24 can be returned until January 31. The extension does not apply to final-sale items or activated subscriptions.

title: Opened Laptop Returns
body: Opened laptops can be returned within 14 days of delivery. After 14 days, support may offer repair service under warranty but should not promise a refund.

title: Standard Shipping
body: Standard shipping usually arrives in 5 to 7 business days after fulfillment. Weekends and holidays do not count as business days.

title: Expedited Shipping
body: Expedited shipping usually arrives in 2 business days after fulfillment. Weather, carrier disruptions, or incorrect addresses can delay delivery.

title: Warranty Basics
body: Most electronics include a one-year limited warranty covering manufacturing defects. Accidental damage and misuse are not covered unless the customer purchased protection.

title: Price Match Policy
body: A price match can be requested within 7 days of purchase when the lower price is from an approved retailer and the item is identical and in stock.

title: Order Lookup Tool Policy
body: When a customer asks about order status and provides an order ID, use the order_status tool before answering. Do not invent shipping status.

title: Subscription Cancellation
body: Monthly subscriptions can be cancelled before the next billing date. Already billed periods are not refunded unless required by law.

title: Final Sale Items
body: Final-sale clearance items are not eligible for return, refund, or exchange except when the item arrives defective.

title: Gift Returns
body: Gift recipients can return eligible items for store credit. Refunds to the original payment method require the purchaser's account.

title: Laptop Sale Announcement
body: Laptop accessories are discounted during the spring sale. This document is marketing content and does not change refund eligibility.
